basic_info.description: This extraordinary home is located on the iconic Lombard Street. Lived in as a single family home, this unique property seamlessly blends historic charm with modern comforts, offering an unparalleled urban living experience. MAIN RESIDENCE: Expansive windows flood the space with natural light and offer breathtaking views. Master suite includes an en-suite bathroom. An additional smaller bedroom is on this level. Top floor has views in all directions and can be used as bedrooms, entertainment or play space. SECOND UNIT: The second unit is perfect opportunity for rental income, guest suite, or multigenerational living. Similar floor plan to main residence, featuring a Mad Men kitchen. Large windows frame views, making every moment here a delight. OUTDOOR OASIS: The crown jewel of this property is a beautifully landscaped garden and courtyard, highlighted by a majestic Redwood Sequoia Tree (SF Landmark Tree #26). Enjoy the beauty of nature in an urban setting. The garden creates a private sanctuary in the midst of the city. This home is a rare find, offering both the prestige of living on Lombard Street and the tranquility of a private garden retreat. Single-family home, compound or units, this space is magic and potential is extraordinary. New roof. ZONED RH3
